symptom: The unmerged v287 authority metadata preflight accepted a synthetic settlement chain whose provisional predecessor was observed before (or exactly at) the first decision, provided a later revision was labeled FINAL. Its terminal-only decision-time check did not reject impossible earlier settlement evidence. No real outcome evidence or production path was used.
lesson: Checking only the terminal revision timestamp allows a caller-provided later FINAL label to conceal an impossible predecision provisional settlement predecessor. Chain shape and finality must not substitute for per-revision decision-time chronology, even in a deny-only untrusted metadata preflight.
guardrail: Validate every settlement revision's observedAt strictly after the first decision before accepting the revision chain as structurally consistent. Keep a negative fixture for predecision/equal-time provisional predecessor plus later FINAL, and a positive postdecision provisional-to-final fixture. Preserve independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false; do not infer external source authentication.
